svg.title: Forty Turns Without Filling the Window
svg.desc: A context bar over a forty-turn research run: tool output fills the window, then pruning, compaction and a subagent summary keep only what the next step needs.
svg.text: Forty Turns Without Filling the Window
Eastbrook Research: keep what the next step needs, not everything it saw.
system and goal 20,000 · tool output 560,000 · reasoning 40,000 = 620,000 of 1,000,000 tokens
TURN 40, WITH PRUNING, COMPACTION AND A SUBAGENT
